summary: Tested the redesigned Seasonal Light feature (manual winter_time overrides + 30-min light-on fallback), replacing the old hour-shortening approach. Backend: created /app/backend/tests/test_winter_season.py (4 tests, all passing) verifying (1) AppSettings no longer has light_winter_shorten_hours, (2) PUT /api/admin/settings still persists light_summer_start/light_winter_start, (3) PUT /api/times/{id} persists and clears winter_time, (4) /api/daily-overview correctly computes is_winter_period and applies apply_winter_times fallback: light-on task shows its explicit override, ALL other tasks (fodring/pleje/lys-off) with no override shift to override+30min, and a 2nd explicit override on a fodring slot correctly takes precedence over the fallback while everything else still falls back correctly. Frontend: verified via Playwright (mobile viewport 390x844) that Admin's Sæsonperiode section shows only the Summer/Winter date pickers (01-03 / 01-09) with the hours input confirmed absent from DOM; Tasks->Tider tab shows a new 'VINTER' column header, 'Auto (+30 min)' muted text for times with no override; tapping edit opens list-item-form with 'Speciel vintertid' toggle (matching description text about the 30-min fallback rule) that reveals a 2nd winter time picker when enabled; full save cycle confirmed - toggling on + saving shows a snowflake badge with the winter time (e.g. '❄ 15:36'), toggling off + saving correctly reverts to 'Auto (+30 min)'. All test data cleaned up and verified via final GET calls: exactly 1 dragon (Sif), all 7 times have winter_time=null, settings restored to light_summer_start='03-01'/light_winter_start='09-01'.
critical_code_review_comments: services/season.py: apply_winter_times logic is clean and well-commented; correctly excludes the light-on slot itself from being shifted unless it has its own override, and re-sorts tasks by resulting time - matches spec exactly.
routes/times.py PUT correctly persists winter_time (including explicit null to clear), and routes/overview.py builds times_winter_map once per request rather than per-dragon - efficient.
No regressions found: models.py AppSettings/AppSettingsUpdate cleanly dropped light_winter_shorten_hours field with no dangling references found in reviewed files.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of tested flows passed (Admin season pickers, Tider winter column, list-item-form winter toggle + save/clear cycle)

seed_data_creation: None persisted - all winter_time overrides and settings changes set during testing were reverted; verified via final GET that DB matches pre-test state exactly (1 dragon Sif, 7 times all winter_time=null, default season dates).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Seasonal Light redesign (winter_time overrides + 30-min fallback) is fully implemented and working correctly on both backend and frontend, no regressions found in quick admin/lists sanity checks (banner/appearance/language sections rendered fine, times list add/edit/delete UI functioned as expected). Only regression NOT explicitly re-verified this run: outside-winter-period unshifted Daily Overview display (not directly tested since it's the pre-existing default state which is inherently exercised whenever is_winter_period=False) - low risk given the code path is a simple no-op skip of apply_winter_times.
